description: This file contains functions and snippets for configuring WiFi networks and interfaces, particularly related to hostapd and wpa_supplicant. It includes configuration generation, rate setting, security parameters, and various network options for wireless access points.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_network
methods.description: Configures a new network block for wpa_supplicant with security and connection parameters.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_prepare_interface
methods.description: Prepares the wpa_supplicant configuration for a given wireless interface, handling modes and bridge settings.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_teardown_interface
methods.description: Removes the configuration files and directories for a specific interface, cleaning up state.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_set_fixed_freq
methods.description: Sets a fixed frequency and bandwidth options for a specific connection.
